# Torque

- Inherits [`Constraint`](constraint.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Torque")`

A constant torque on the part its `Attachment0` is on: something that keeps being twisted.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RelativeTo` | `Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo` | `Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.Attachment0` | read/write | The frame the torque is written in. |
| `Torque` | `vector` | `vector.create(0, 0, 0)` | read/write | The torque, in newton-metres about each axis of the frame `RelativeTo` names. |
